sourceNote: CS:GO Weapon Case: Official Counter-Strike 2 weapon-case drop odds — the same for every case: Mil-Spec 79.92%, Restricted 15.98%, Classified 3.20%, Covert 0.64%, Rare Special (knife/glove) 0.26%. These are Valve's disclosed rates, not a community estimate, so confidence is OFFICIAL — the strongest tier. Within a tier every skin is equally likely; the wear (Factory New … Battle-Scarred) and ~10% StatTrak sub-distribution is modelled at the price layer, not here.
